observations: Black electronic keyboard with 'YAMAHA' branding on the front panel.
The keyboard has 49 keys (white and black).
A control panel with buttons, a small LCD screen, and a circular navigation wheel is visible.
The keyboard is resting on a red plastic chair.
Watermarks for 'LUCKY SOUNDS SERVICES LTD' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' are present on all photos.
The item appears to be in good cosmetic condition.

claims.evidence: The photos show a Yamaha keyboard, but 'professional' is a subjective claim that cannot be verified remotely.

risks.risk: The keyboard may not power on or produce sound.
risks.proof: A video showing the keyboard being turned on and playing a scale or demo song.

risks.risk: Individual keys or buttons may be unresponsive or 'dead'.
risks.proof: A video of a chromatic scale being played across all keys.

risks.risk: The LCD screen may be cracked or have dead pixels.
risks.proof: A clear, close-up photo of the screen while the unit is powered on.

proof_requests: Video of the keyboard powered on and playing a demo song.
Video of a full chromatic scale being played to check all keys.
Close-up photo of the LCD screen while the unit is on.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a Yamaha electronic keyboard. It can be priced at its worst-case functional state (non-working) until proof of operation is provided.
